objective_for_doctor: Assess and diagnose the patient presenting with progressively worsening shortness of breath over the past 2 months.

turns.doctor_opening: Hello, what brings you in today? Could you tell me about yourself and what's been going on?
turns.patient_opening: Doctor: Hello, what brings you in today? Could you tell me about yourself and what's been going on? Patient: For the past two months my breathing has been getting worse, especially with activity—I don’t feel it at rest. I sometimes have a dry cough, but I’ve had no fever, chills, or night sweats.

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any swelling in your joints?
turns.patient_answer: Doctor: Have you noticed any swelling in your joints? Patient: No, I haven’t noticed any joint swelling or pain. It’s mostly been the shortness of breath when I’m active, and the occasional dry cough.

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any bumps, sores, or unusual growths on your scalp?
turns.patient_answer: No, I haven’t noticed any bumps, sores, or unusual growths on my scalp.

turns.doctor_question: Have you been experiencing any itching or discomfort in your skin lately?
turns.patient_answer: Patient: No, I haven’t had itching or unusual skin discomfort—my main issue has just been getting more short of breath with activity and an occasional dry cough.

turns.doctor_question: Do you have any trouble lifting your arms above your head?
turns.patient_answer: Patient: No, I don’t really have trouble lifting my arms above my head, and I haven’t noticed any muscle weakness—just that my breathing gets worse when I’m active.

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any loss of vision that isn’t accompanied by pain?
turns.patient_answer: Patient: No, I haven’t had any loss of vision, and there’s been no pain with my eyes either.

turns.doctor_question: Have you had a fever that’s been so high it feels like you’re burning up—something above 104°F (40°C) that makes you feel extremely hot or dizzy?
turns.patient_answer: No, I haven’t had any fever, and I haven’t felt extremely hot or dizzy. My symptoms have mainly been shortness of breath that worsens with activity and an occasional dry cough.

turns.doctor_question: Have you been feeling unusually stressed or overwhelmed lately?
turns.patient_answer: No, I haven’t been feeling unusually stressed or overwhelmed lately. My breathing symptoms are the main thing that’s been bothering me, especially when I’m active.

turns.doctor_question: Have you experienced any burning or discomfort when you urinate?
turns.patient_answer: Patient: No, I haven’t noticed any burning or discomfort when I urinate. My main problem has been worsening shortness of breath with activity, and occasionally a dry cough.

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed a lump in your breast that feels firm and hasn’t moved?
turns.patient_answer: No, I haven’t noticed any lump or firmness in my breast area. My only ongoing problems are getting more short of breath with activity and an occasional dry, nonproductive cough.
